cadence_projection_collisions.scope: Equal scalar cadence does not reconstruct distinct retained preparations or histories; no physical degeneracy is asserted.

dimensions.identifiability: Multiplying a dimensionless trace statistic by any positive correctly dimensioned scale preserves dimensions; dimensions do not select the scale.
dimensions.transition_energy_vs_rest_mass: Even importing E=h*nu and a mass-equivalent E/c^2 would describe the selected transition; it does not identify the neutral atom rest mass.

fixed: one common parameter vector per witness
obstruction.result: Two explicit global map witnesses preserve every listed constraint but give different nonreference frequency, energy and mass outputs.
obstruction.scope: Non-identifiability within these declared map families; not proof that every future AOD application must remain underdetermined.
